name: Kiya Shiina
source:
"This is the first time I've ever had to rely on someone else like this. Because, I've always been alone."

The confident genius artist of Jupiter.
The Jupiter prince.

The genius prince of Jupiter who can do everything effortlessly.
He's a little contrary and is a realist who hates people who talk easily about their dreams.
He has a lot of pride and looks down on others.
He treasures the time he has alone and enjoys reading and appreciating music.
